title: Defaults for new tasks
description: Values every new task in this project starts with. Anything left empty here is simply not set; you can always type another value on the task.
loadFailed: Defaults could not be loaded. Close this window and try again.
fieldsHelp: Pick a value to make it the default for new tasks. Leave a field empty for no default — for example Fact, which should start blank.
noFields: This project has no fields yet.
fieldEmpty: No default: new tasks leave this empty.
footnote: Defaults apply to tasks created in the table, the API and MCP, and to subtasks (a team estimate only to top-level tasks). They never change existing tasks. A value typed on the task always wins; if the task above has no value, the fixed default (if any) is used.
aboveHelp: “Same as the task above” takes the value from the task directly above the new one in the same section (or in the same list when there are no sections). If there is no task above, nothing is set.
daysInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 0 to 366.
pickPerson: Choose the person who gets new tasks.
priorityFromAbove: Priority: same as the task above
estimateFromAbove: Team estimate: same as the task above
fieldFromAbove: New tasks copy this field from the task above.
